# note: Emptied on 2026-09-10. The last divergent section on this key was JdkOnlyPlatformProbe vthreads, and it was ONE cell: handoffs=, the count of SynchronousQueue polls that returned a value. That count is load-fragile on HotSpot too, so it was never measuring this VM. It now asks for the shape instead -- handoffsPositive (the carrier did not deadlock, which is what the row was really asserting) and handoffsBounded (0..64, so the cell cannot decay into a constant true) -- and both are deterministic. Measured rather than assumed, under the condition the 2026-08-30 phase-2 adjudication named as the one that perturbs it (several probe instances overlapping, NOT steady CPU load: an attempt with four spinners at load average 7.5 did not reproduce it and was discarded as void). Three corpus instances at once, control arm with the raw count: observed 1, 0 and 2 divergent sections with handoff cells 64, 59 and 64. Same machine minutes later, shaped arm, three instances at once: 0, 0 and 0. The paired evidence for an empty baseline is the inverse ratchet, recorded below.
#
# The gate fails when this set GROWS. A line that stops diverging is
# reported and passes, so a fix is never blocked by the gate that
# measured it — re-freeze afterwards to keep the ratchet tight.
